4.2.6 Information on persons arrested for every case under the IPC and the L&SL, from 1989 to 1993 has been presented in Table-33. It is observed that except for a few crime-heads such as ‘Preparation & Assembly for Dacoity’, ‘Antiquity & Art Treasure Act’, this ratio is more or less stable. The ratio of persons arrested to the cases registered against them was 1.5 under the IPC crimes as against 1.2 under the L&crimes. However, the high ratio noticed in of ‘Riots’ (5.6) and ‘Preparation & Assembly Dacoity’ (5.4) is to be noticed as one specific such types of crimes.
